content.description:
✨ ONE PLATFORM, A WHOLE WORLD OF OPPORTUNITY

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time

- Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award by Newsweek

- A G2 Spring 2026 Leader https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026 across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

- The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

THE ROLE

Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within UTC−6 to UTC+3.

All applications will be reviewed after the submission deadline on Dec 4th, and we’ll be in touch with next steps shortly after. We appreciate your patience and interest in joining the team.

Role Summary

Own Oyster’s performance marketing strategy, and the qualified pipeline it generates. As our Paid Media Manager you’ll be a hands-on individual contributor responsible for our inbound digital demand channels, combining execution with strategic ownership across the broader digital mix.

Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation and Growth Marketing, you’ll inherit an established program, protect what is working, and use evidence to decide what to improve, expand, or retire. You’ll work with agencies, paid media vendors, and cross-functional partners to deliver meaningful paid-sourced and paid-influenced pipeline while optimizing ROAS. This is an opportunity to own both the strategy and its business outcomes, not simply execute campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

- Own and evolve performance marketing strategy across the wider inbound digital channel mix, including paid social, programmatic display, digital out of home, G2 and review-site advertising, and affiliate programs.

- Partner with the Search & Web lead on landing-page testing, conversion tracking, and attribution rules so paid channel contribution is measured consistently across the mix.

- Take over live existing campaigns smoothly, maintaining continuity while auditing account structure, targeting, creative, conversion tracking, and performance.

- Run a weekly operating rhythm of performance reviews, optimization, testing, and evidence-led scaling; maintain clear decisions on what to continue, change, or retire.

- Connect campaign performance to qualified pipeline, distinguish paid-sourced and paid-influenced contribution, and optimize ROAS rather than relying on platform activity metrics alone.

- Partner with Campaigns, Product Marketing, Operations, and web teams on messaging, landing-page conversion, lead quality, and follow-up across the funnel.

- Manage affiliate/display agencies and paid media vendor relationships with clear objectives, quality standards, and accountability for results.

- Apply AI and automation to improve analysis, reporting, experimentation, and campaign workflows, validating outputs and protecting sensitive data.

- Stay current with platform, algorithm, and industry changes; translate useful developments into controlled tests and sustainable improvements.

Core Requirements

- Demonstrated hands-on experience running paid inbound channels, with clear examples of the decisions you made and the results they produced.

- Proven ownership of multiple digital channels, connecting strategy and execution to qualified pipeline or comparable commercial outcomes.

- Experience using an AI-native working style: integrating AI into real workflows, critically checking outputs, and improving how work gets done.

- Strong analytical judgment: able to interpret channel and funnel performance, assess measurement limitations, and use evidence to guide optimization and ROAS decisions.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to align marketing, sales, operations, web partners, agencies, and vendors around shared outcomes.

- Confidence inheriting an existing program, expanding its scope, and deciding what to continue, change, and retire without disrupting effective live activity.

- Senior individual-contributor ownership: independently drive complex work, make sound trade-offs, communicate risks, and follow through on outcomes in a distributed environment.

Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience

Proposed preferences—not screening prerequisites:

- B2B experience connecting paid media to qualified opportunities and revenue.

- Affiliate or programmatic display agency management, including channel-quality and attribution scrutiny.

- Landing-page experimentation and conversion optimization in partnership with web and messaging teams.

- Improving measurement, reporting, or automation across a multi-channel acquisition program.

This might not be right for you if...

- You are seeking a people-management role rather than hands-on senior individual-contributor ownership.

- You prefer campaign execution without accountability for pipeline outcomes and measurement quality.

- You want to build only from a blank slate rather than inherit, assess, and evolve an existing program.

- You prefer an unchanging channel plan over a weekly rhythm of analysis, testing, and evidence-led decisions.

- You are not interested in incorporating AI into your work while remaining accountable for quality and judgment.

You'll also need

- A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.

HOW WE WORK TOGETHER AT OYSTER

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d so other global teams can learn from us.

HOW YOU WORK

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395 a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

- Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

- Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

- Mental health support: Access Plumm https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7, our mental well-being service.

- Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

- Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

- WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ THE BEST JOBS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE TO EVERYONE

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers http://www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye.
